'''Pedro Arrojo-Agudo''' ([[Madrid]], 13 April 1951) is a Spanish physicist, economist, [[environmentalist]], and a professor at the [[University of Zaragoza]]. He was awarded the [[Goldman Environmental Prize]] in 2003, for his contributions to conservation of water.<ref name="goldman">{{cite web |title=Europe 2003. Pedro Arrojo-Agudo. Spain. Rivers & Dams |url=http://www.goldmanprize.org/node/74 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110615065741/http://www.goldmanprize.org/node/74 |archive-date=15 June 2011 |accessdate=4 December 2010 |website=Goldman Environmental Prize}}</ref> He was made the [[United Nations special rapporteur|United Nations Special Rapporteur]] on the human rights to safe drinking water and sanitation in October 2020.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mr. Pedro Arrojo-Agudo, Special Rapporteur on the human rights to safe drinking water and sanitation |url=https://www.ohchr.org/EN/Issues/WaterAndSanitation/SRWater/Pages/PedroArrojoAgudo.aspx |accessdate=2 November 2020 |website=[[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]]}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Born in Madrid, Arrojo-Agudo grew up in [[Granada]] before moving to [[Zaragoza]] in 1969 to study physics, graduating in 1973.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Barral |first=Cristina |date=5 May 2003 |title=Uno de los detractores del embalse recibe el Goldman de medio ambiente |trans-title=One of the reservoir's detractors receives the Goldman Environmental Prize |url=https://www.lavozdegalicia.es/noticia/pontevedra/2003/05/05/detractores-embalse-recibe-goldman-medio-ambiente/0003_1655490.htm |access-date=13 August 2024 |website=[[La Voz de Galicia]] |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Roy |first=Antonio Calvo |date=10 January 2004 |title="Hay grandes negocios en la trastienda del Plan Hidrológico" |trans-title="There are big businesses in the back room of the Hydrological Plan" |url=https://elpais.com/diario/2004/01/11/domingo/1073796755_850215.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231023073541/https://elpais.com/diario/2004/01/11/domingo/1073796755_850215.html |archive-date=23 October 2023 |access-date=13 August 2024 |work=[[El País]] |language=es |issn=1134-6582}}</ref> He earned his doctorate in physics from the University of Zaragoza with a thesis on [[fluid mechanics]].<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=Simulación numérica de Montecarlo para reacciones ácido-base en flujo turbulento casi isótropo |url=https://dialnet.unirioja.es/servlet/tesis?codigo=205936 |publisher=University of Zaragoza |date=1987 |degree=PhD |language=es |first=Pedro |last=Arrojo Agudo}}</ref> He became the first Spaniard to receive the Goldman Environmental Prize for the European region based on his opposition to the proposed [[National Hydrological Plan]] of 2001.<ref name="goldman" />

In the [[2015 Spanish general election|2015 general election]], he led the deputies list from [[Podemos (Spanish political party)|Podemos]] in Zaragoza, winning his seat. He was later elected as deputy from Unidos Podemos por Zaragoza in the [[2016 Spanish general election|2016 general election]] and served as spokesman of the Committee on Agriculture, Food and Environment.<ref>{{Cite web |date=21 December 2015 |title=El exJEMAD fichado por Podemos se queda fuera del Congreso |trans-title=Former Defence Staff filed with Podemos is left out of Congress |url=https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20151221/30944849913/el-exjemad-fichado-por-podemos-se-queda-fuera-del-congreso.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230802090637/https://www.lavanguardia.com/vida/20151221/30944849913/el-exjemad-fichado-por-podemos-se-queda-fuera-del-congreso.html |archive-date=2 August 2023 |access-date=13 August 2024 |website=[[La Vanguardia]] |language=es}}</ref>
